title: Da Nang Motorcycle Tours: Enduro trip through cloud forests and mountain passes | Enduro-Vietnam
description: Enduro motorcycle tours in Da Nang. Powerful bikes, professional off-road tires, and hidden locations in the Truong Son Mountains that are inaccessible to regular transportation. We work all year round, we provide training for beginners.

children.text: Our bases are located in key locations across Vietnam, providing rental and support services wherever you need them.
We have conducted hundreds of tours and know the safest and most exciting routes in the country
WHAT ARE THE MOTORCYCLE TOURS IN DA NANG:

This enduro tour is your ticket to the breathtaking landscapes of Da Nang, where the mountains literally meet the sea. Forget the city traffic and head to the Son Tra Peninsula. You'll ride through dense tropical forests on red clay trails, tackle rocky climbs, and reach heights where the entire Danang Bay is visible. The route includes abandoned military roads and narrow paths used only by locals. You will experience the contrast between the salty sea breeze and the humid mountain air. This is a concentrated dose of adrenaline, technical riding, and stunning coastal scenery. Perfect for those who want to see the wild side of Da Nang in just a few hours!
Booking confirmation: record at least 2 days in advance. The organizer will confirm the booking for the date you have chosen, after which you will make a 30% prepayment.

This extended enduro tour takes you to the legendary Hai Van Pass — but not the way tourists see it. We avoid the asphalt and take the old "Cloud Pass" trails, winding through steep ridges and dense vegetation. You'll explore the rugged terrain of the Annamite Mountains, cross small streams, and discover hidden waterfalls where you can cool off. The route is a mix of high-speed dirt sections and technical forest paths. From the ruins of old French forts to the pristine beauty of Lang Co Bay from above, this tour offers a complete immersion into the wild nature of Central Vietnam. It’s a full day of freedom, speed, and technical challenges that will test your skills and reward you with epic views.
Booking confirmation: record at least 2 days in advance. The organizer will confirm the booking for the date you have chosen, after which you will make a 30% prepayment.
💲 THE PRICE OF THE TOUR (3 hours)

We chose to take the enduro tour in Da Nang alongside my father. He has extensive motorcycle riding experience, while I have nearly none. I was quite anxious, thinking my lack of skills would ruin the trip. However, it was quite the opposite: within just 1-2 hours, Andrey got me on the bike and covered the basics and nuances of riding.

During our time on the tour, we embraced the adventure — riding through stunning cloud forests, tackling challenging mountain passes, and experiencing the diverse terrain of Da Nang. It was an incredible experience that defined our time in Vietnam! 😊 I must highlight Andrey's exceptional coaching — his expertise made enduro accessible and exciting for both my father and me. I highly recommend this journey for anyone looking for thrills amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Da Nang!

My partner surprised me with this tour for my birthday, fully aware of my passion for motorcycles. She only had a bit of experience riding off-road, so she felt quite anxious during the initial days of the journey. I'm also not an expert in enduro riding. Nevertheless, our guide, Boris, was incredibly supportive and focused on teaching us, turning this adventure into more of a learning experience than just a standard tour.

He spent a good hour on the training ground to ensure everyone felt comfortable, and interestingly, Sarah even rode solo for a bit, although just in a straight line ;) Ultimately, Mark made a daring choice: he invited Sarah as his co-rider on his bike. Together, we tackled around 60 km of rugged terrain, navigating through rocky paths, deep ditches, and steep slopes in the breathtaking Da Nang area. At times, the obstacles seemed insurmountable, but watching how effortlessly Mark handled them (even with a passenger!) motivated me to push through. Of course, our gear took a beating... Every moment of this ride will be etched in my memory, and my casual chats with Mark left a wonderful impression. The cherry on top was a heartfelt gift from him! It truly moved me! This adventure through the stunning landscapes of Da Nang is worth every penny — the memories are invaluable! I wholeheartedly recommend it to couples looking for thrills and a deeper connection with nature. 😊

This is a one-day enduro tour through the scenic surroundings of Danang — a mix of nature, adrenaline, and real off-road riding.
You just show up — everything else is already taken care of. Before we start, there's a short training session to help you feel confident on the trail.
Throughout the ride, an instructor accompanies your group: giving you tips, helping on technical sections, and supporting you whenever you need it.
The route is tailored to your group's skill level: you can choose an easier format or a more challenging option with climbs, descents, and technical terrain.
The main part of the day is spent riding with stops at beautiful spots and a meal included along the way.
This is a route you can't find and safely ride solo — wild trails, hidden locations, and off-the-beaten-path spots around Danang.
You don't need enduro experience — just confident motorcycle riding skills with manual transmission. If you're uncertain, you can do the training session before we hit the road.
This isn't just a tour — it's a day that becomes one of the most unforgettable experiences of your trip.

Do you supply any riding gear, helmets, or emergency equipment for the tours?
Da Nang Motorcycle Tours: Enduro trip through coastal roads and scenic trails | Enduro-Vietnam
Where are we going? Only in Da Nang?
We ride through the scenic landscapes of Da Nang and the stunning areas of the Central Highlands nearby. We have the best trails suited for every skill level.
We begin our journey early in the morning, around 7:00, and ride until dusk, approximately 18:00. You can opt for a rental of any length, up to a full day.
Can I drive without any driving experience?
Of course! We train everyone, regardless of age or gender. In just one day of training, you will learn the necessary skills and feel confident to ride on your own. We guarantee your riding success⚡️
What gear is provided in the package?

The rental package provides an enduro motorcycle along with a safety helmet. We suggest wearing sturdy, closed-toe footwear suitable for rugged terrain. Additionally, opt for laced shoes as flip-flops are not advisable.
Do I need an international driving license for motorcycle tours in Da Nang?

Although a license is formally required, Da Nang is a hub for enduro enthusiasts. The local authorities typically allow tourists on enduro motorcycles to ride without concerns. Enjoy the adventure safely!💫
What should be left as collateral for Da Nang Motorcycle Tours: Enduro adventures through lush rainforests and scenic mountain routes?
You can secure your ride by leaving a deposit of 200💲 or using your passport for minor repairs.
Who is responsible for motorcycle repairs or damages?
Anything that occurs due to the client's negligence (accidents, damage) will be covered by the client during repairs.
Can you provide any city-related advice (other than rental)?
Absolutely! We will be excited to share hidden gems to explore👀, tasty local eateries🍔, vibrant bars to enjoy🍻, and upcoming events to experience💃🕺.
Does the Tour around Dalat include a visit to the waterfalls?

Of course! Our routes include the coolest natural spots in Dalat. We often drive right next to the iconic Datanla and Elephant Waterfalls, as well as take a look at Kau Dat Tea Hill. We can even stop by Chuk Lam Monastery for a quick overview. It will be an unforgettable Tour of the surroundings of Dalat! 🏞️🏍️
Do you only arrange enduro tours, or are there additional adventures available?

We specialize in enduro motorcycles and off-road adventures. For those seeking added thrill, we also suggest exploring our trusted partners for activities like the Dalat Canyoning Tour, featuring exhilarating waterfall descents! 🧗👍
Is it possible to combine an enduro tour with a coffee tour?

Yes, this is a great idea! We will be delighted to incorporate elements of the Da Nang Motorcycle Tours into your itinerary. You will not only experience the stunning landscapes but also ride through the beautiful cloud forests and mountain passes, making unforgettable memories. Everything is flexible with us! 🏍️🌄
How is your Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) different from Enduro Tour+?

The difference is huge! An Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) is when you're being driven by a guide. Our tour is your personal adrenaline rush! You're in control of the dirt bike (Enduro), and we'll tackle the most challenging off-road trails together. It's an active, self-paced adventure! 🤘🚦
What is the weather in Da Nang by month? When is the best time to visit, taking into account the rainy season?

The weather in Da Nang, especially during the rainy season, can be unpredictable. Rain can appear unexpectedly, but we have a tip! Our observations show that on many days, there are clear periods perfect for adventure. This is an excellent time to enjoy the scenic rides and breathtaking views. We suggest setting off early! 🌤️🚴‍♂️
Do you offer both enduro motorcycle rentals and motocross motorcycle rentals?

Our primary offering is enduro motorcycles designed for off-road adventures. While we don't provide cross-country bikes directly, we can refer you to trusted local Vietnamese providers for rentals. Please note that their prices may vary. If you're looking for additional amenities like an outdoor kitchen or barbecue, feel free to inquire! 😉💸
